_comment: Verification config for per-device heterogeneous tp_hardware (feat/per-device-profiles). Intended shape: TP=2 with rank 0 on V100 and rank 1 on V100_700MHz. NOTE (data gap): a true end-to-end run requires tp2 profiles for BOTH clocks under profiler/perf/<hw>/Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507/fp16/tp2/. As of this branch only V100 has tp2; V100_700MHz (and all other V100 clock variants) only have tp1. _load_perf_db will raise FileNotFoundError on the missing V100_700MHz/.../tp2 folder. Profile V100_700MHz at tp2 to enable the e2e hetero run. Qwen3-30B is MoE, so this config also exercises the per-device expert-imbalance energy path (use --expert-routing-policy RAND).
